canonical_project: Cable & Wireless Data Center 1 - Bon Espoir (Bon Espoir Data Centre)
notes: Confirmed commercial/operator facility. Uptime Institute award page lists client Cable & Wireless (Seychelles) Limited, project 'Data Center 1 - Bon Espoir', location Anse Boileau, Seychelles (A-grade for facility/location). Seychelles Nation (22 Nov 2024) reports inauguration of the state-of-the-art Bon Espoir Data Centre; press (Nation 2023-08-22 announcement, 2024-09-21 launch, 2024-11-22 inauguration) cites ~US$3m capex (B-grade for dates/capex). Site also described as Bon Espoir, Montagne Posee. CWS/LinkedIn marketing claims 'Seychelles' First Tier IV Data Centre' and a vendor (IP Engineering) LinkedIn post claims a Tier IV DC went live in Seychelles in early 2024 - Tier claim is marketing/vendor only (C), not confirmed by Uptime registry extraction; capacity not public, do not infer MW.
